subject: general
question:
Choose the appropriate tenses to fill in the blanks in the given sentence:

Vishnu ________ to work in Japan, so he _______ Japanese.
solution:
The correct answer is "**wants, is learning**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ***complete sentence*** is:

 
 
• ​Vishnu wants to work in Japan, so he is learning Japanese. 
 
 
 
• ​The above sentence is in its ***Present Continuous form***.
 
• The ***present continuous*** is a verb tense employed in modern English that combines the present tense with the constant aspect.
 
• It is also known as the*** present progressive*** or*** present imperfect***.
 
• It comprises the ***verb's present participle*** and the present tense form of being.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A verb form called a*** tense ***allows you to indicate time.
 
• The verb's tense indicates the ***time period*** in which an event, an object, or a person occurred or performed an action.
 
• The*** three basic tenses*** are:
 
 
• ***Past***
 
• ***Present***
 
• ***Future***
